extraction: Preserved selected markup, scoped product CSS, shared data and local interaction code.
Removed the three unselected variant DOMs and their top-level rendering functions.
Replaced host carousel with two external reference navigation buttons; product UI unchanged.
Embedded official Lucide ESM rendering helpers and only the used icon data, with original licenses; no authored SVG paths.
Retained only the original host typography/icon primitives needed to preserve the selected rendered design: heading/paragraph fonts, 18 px small-text line height, 16 px icons, font smoothing.
No runtime network requests or MES connection.
Product fonts use the original family declarations; screenshot environment supplies Noto Sans CJK TC through Fontconfig.

lucide.distribution: lucide v1.8.0; selected icon data plus original ESM rendering helpers

caveats: Reference navigation compares two independent demo states; it is NOT the product settings switch or shared production state architecture.
All records, dates, amounts, permissions and eligibility are illustrative fixtures, not current MES data or business rules.
Local regex parsing and canned explanations are demo shortcuts, not the real AI entry/router.
The sample covers one report scenario; production must cover schedule/report/mold and each existing business action.
Client-side review and completion are illustrative; production must use server preview, version/actor/auth checks and actual confirmation outcomes.
Do not copy the 24-row in-memory search, four-row pagination, fixed dates, or completed-row disabling as backend contracts.
No pending/unknown recovery, async save conflict, cross-tab arbitration or mode switch persistence is implemented in the demo.
The reference header and preview badge are presentation context; latest approved product shell and brand changes take precedence.
Outer min-heights, border radius and screenshot dimensions are comparison framing, not fixed production viewport requirements.
